b_01M0TKAWW70B0CBZ4YTN573D2D.content: This job_definition represents the hot tub refurbishment job type through which the project's tiered Base/Premium/Platinum restoration packages are likely executed as individual jobs.
b_01M0TKAWW70B0CBZ4YTN573D2D.falsification_test: If a job created under this job_definition has no relation to the restoration package tiers or pricing, this belief would be wrong.

b_01M0TKAWW8GTNFJ7C6HWN0FB7V.content: The 'shop' inspection_type setting implies teardown/inspection for this job type happens after the spa is transported to the shop, consistent with the round-trip transport model described in the project's Restoration Service Agreement.
b_01M0TKAWW8GTNFJ7C6HWN0FB7V.falsification_test: If a job of this type documents on-site (not shop) inspection or teardown, this belief would be wrong.
